result.summary: The environment features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but the crossing is wide and the markings are significantly faded. The lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals and the wide roadway geometry increase exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The lack of a median or curb extensions results in a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked continental crosswalk. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian signals or traffic calming measures prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads that show the remaining time to cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked crosswalks and traffic signal control. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and signal control with a 'No Turn on Red' restriction. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing distance is relatively long without a refuge island, and parked vehicles may obstruct sight lines.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street near the intersection may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway before the crosswalk

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
